entry.title: Hello, world
entry.content:
This is the first post on my new website. I plan to use this space for occasional notes — on papers I am reading, things I am working on, and the odd technical aside.

Writing a post is easy: create a Markdown file in the _posts/ folder named like YYYY-MM-DD-title.md, add the small header block you see at the top of this file, and write below it. The site rebuilds itself automatically after you push the change.

More soon.
